subject: gk
question: On 7 November 2022, the Supreme Court of India upheld the reservations for the weaker sections (EWS). Which of the following amendments brought this reservation in the first place?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**103rd Amendment of the Constitution.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Introduction of EWS Reservation:**

 
 
• Objective: Provides 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in educational institutions and government jobs.
 
• Criteria: Applies to individuals not covered by SC, ST, or OBC reservations, based on economic status.
 
 
 
• **Amendments to the Constitution:**
 
 
• Article 15: Allows for the provision of reservation in educational institutions for EWS.
 
• Article 16: Permits reservation in government employment for EWS.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility:**
 
 
• Income Limit: Individuals with annual income below ₹8 lakh or possessing less than 5 acres of land are eligible.
 
 
 
• **Impact:**
 
 
• Expansion: Increases the scope of affirmative action by including economically disadvantaged individuals who are not otherwise covered by existing reservation policies.
